tests.title: Technical error diagnosis
tests.prompt: Analyze this error page. In at most three bullets state: (1) what is visibly certain, (2) the most direct technical cause supported by the screenshot, and (3) one next check. Do not invent password, firewall, or service status.

tests.title: UI layout issue
tests.prompt: What is the main visible layout problem in this Projects table? Name the problem and the affected element.

tests.title: Screenshot plus Blade/Livewire code
tests.prompt:
The screenshot shows a visually normal Save button. The Blade code below belongs to it:

<x-actions.button wire:click="save" wire:loading="disabled" wire:target="save">Save</x-actions.button>

The project-specific Web Awesome wrapper requires the button to receive the loading state while saving. What exact change is required? Return only the corrected component line.

tests.title: OCR technical logs
tests.prompt: Read the screenshot exactly. Return only: (a) the release value, (b) the Redis endpoint, and (c) the reconnect attempt number in the WARN line. Exact format: RELEASE | ENDPOINT | ATTEMPT

tests.title: GUI grounding
tests.prompt: Click the 'Rotate key' button for the Production API. Return exactly one JSON object with pixel coordinates from the top-left: {"x": integer, "y": integer}.

tests.title: Technical diagram reasoning
tests.prompt: According to the diagram, which specific connection fails? Answer with source -> destination and name the visual indication.

tests.title: Visual epistemic restraint
tests.prompt: What can be concluded about the incident from this monitoring screenshot? State one certainty and then what cannot be determined. Do not draw a specific conclusion about credentials, the firewall, or database service status.
